slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Managed IT in Birmingham: frequently asked questions

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: Do you have an office in Birmingham?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: No. Our offices are at 124 City Rd in London and Caxton Point in Stevenage, and we are straight about that rather than listing a virtual address. Birmingham is covered by our UK service desk plus a team of field engineers who travel to customer sites. In practice most issues never need a visit at all: we respond the same working day and resolve most issues remotely. When a site visit is requested, we aim to have an engineer with you the same working day.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: We run warehouse and office sites. Can you support both?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Yes, and they need treating differently. Offices are largely about people, devices and Microsoft 365; a warehouse is about coverage, resilience and hardware that has to survive being used properly. Both sit under one support agreement so you are not managing two suppliers.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Can you help us move off ageing on-premise servers?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: That is one of the most common projects we run. It is scoped properly first, migrated in planned stages rather than one risky weekend, and the old kit is only decommissioned once the new setup has genuinely proven itself.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: What size of business do you usually work with?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Mostly businesses from a handful of users up to a few hundred. That is deliberate: it means you deal with people who know your setup rather than whoever is next in a queue of thousands of accounts.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: How quickly can an engineer reach us?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: Most issues are resolved remotely and quickly, usually within the same working day. Where a visit is genuinely needed, we aim to have a field engineer with you the same working day.
